brief.question: Rebuild a lightweight desktop statistics package with the same core features as the person's statistics program: a data editor (data and variable views), menus for data handling, transforms, analyses and charts, and an output viewer with result tables.
brief.purpose: The person wants a light, smooth replacement for a heavy statistics package.
constraints: Clean room: nothing inside the original is read or run
No reference pictures were provided; layout comes from the request and general knowledge of this kind of program
No brand names or logos; neutral app name
brief.done_when: The app builds, opens with a data grid, variable view, working analysis menus (descriptives, frequencies, crosstabs, t-tests, ANOVA, correlation, regression, charts), an output viewer, CSV open/save, and a --screenshot option that saves a non-blank picture.
